{"ascii":"Application Composition and Transports
|-- [M] Server composition: createBackend selects implementations and connects ports
|   |-- Exposes: routes {core, mapping}, liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows,
|   |           pushIntegrations, dispose()
|   |   `-- Repositories, runtimes and remaining service instances stay inside the wiring
|   |-- [O] Persistence and core services
|   |   |-- DiagramStore(projectRoot, diagramsDirectory) [shared STORE]
|   |   |   `-- storeRoot anchors filesystem stores for workspaces, contexts, chats,
|   |   |       changes, comparisons, evals, histories and integration records
|   |   |-- CoreApplication <- STORE + corpusAccess
|   |   |   `-- corpusAccess exposes provider, document-line reads and discovery
|   |   |-- ProjectSourceService <- STORE + corpusAccess + optional language service
|   |   |-- ProjectCatalogService <- STORE
|   |   `-- Mapping state
|   |       |-- MappingDiagramService <- STORE + corpusAccess + WorkspaceRecordStore
|   |       `-- MappingWorkspaceService <- STORE + MappingWorkspaceStore
|   |           `-- Also receives FileDiagramAgentContextStore
|   |-- [O] Runtime selection
|   |   |-- NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT == "fake"
|   |   |   `-- Fake local chat, mapping, diagram edit, compaction, eval and comparison
|   |   |-- Otherwise
|   |   |   |-- Codex: local chat and comparison
|   |   |   |-- Pi: mapping, diagram edit and file compaction
|   |   |   `-- AgentContextEvalRuntime: eval execution
|   |   |-- piEnabled is passed to concrete integrations
|   |   |   `-- Diff workflows and push integrations also receive enablement
|   |   |-- lspEnabled == true -> construct ProjectLanguageService
|   |   `-- Separate constructions, outside the fake switch
|   |       `-- QuickJsAgentRuntime, StdioCodexConnection and PiDiffSessionRuntime
|   |-- [M] Agent access and live canvas
|   |   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge wraps CanvasSessionBridge [shared BRIDGE]
|   |   |   |-- LiveCanvasService receives list() and context-dispatch callbacks
|   |   |   |-- ChangeSessionService receives BRIDGE + STORE + change-session store
|   |   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService receives BRIDGE, diagrams, STORE,
|   |   |       QuickJS runtime, changes, edit runtime, contexts and API projection
|   |   |-- AgentContextLibrary [shared CONTEXTS]
|   |   |   |-- FileAgentContextRepository + FileAgentContextSources
|   |   |   `-- Supplies AgentContextService; also injected into chat, evals, experiments
|   |   `-- [D] Context source binding depends on sourceId
|   |       |-- "repo-" prefix -> STORE.repositories.resolveCheckoutRoot(sourceId)
|   |       |   `-- Produces {kind: 'git-worktree', root}
|   |       `-- Other source -> load project + resolveDiagramSource(projectId, sourceId)
|   |           |-- No project -> AGENT_CONTEXT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
|   |           `-- Resolved binding supplies corpus
|   |-- [M] Chat, changes and integrations
|   |   |-- AgentChatService <- StdioCodexConnection + FileChatStore
|   |   |   |-- Also receives live canvas, BRIDGE and CONTEXTS
|   |   |   `-- ChatDiagramTools and MappingChatMcpBinding both receive the agent service
|   |   |-- LocalChatService <- STORE + corpusAccess + selected local-chat runtime
|   |   |-- FileCompactionService <- core + selected runtime + FileCompactionStore
|   |   |   `-- Prompt loading and agent settings supplied as callbacks
|   |   |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService <- changes + agent + PiDiffSessionRuntime
|   |   |   `-- FileDiffSessionRunStore + prompts + repository-backed source reader
|   |   `-- PushIntegrationService <- FilePushIntegrationStore + GitPushSource
|   |       `-- Receives the same diff workflow service
|   `-- [M] Generation, comparison and evaluation
|       |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog <- STORE [shared CATALOG]
|       |-- CompareSessionService <- workspace + FileCompareSessionStore + CATALOG + STORE
|       |-- EvalReferenceService <- reference/group stores + STORE
|       |-- EvalPromptService <- prompt/snapshot stores + STORE + references
|       |-- EvalRunService [shared EVALS]
|       |   |-- Receives compare sessions, workspace, STORE, CONTEXTS, prompts and CATALOG
|       |   |-- Also receives eval-run store, selected eval runtime and rollup-run store
|       |   |-- Adds layout templates and FileCanvasTimeline
|       |   `-- ReferenceGenerationService receives session store + agent chat + EVALS
|       |-- ComparisonGenerationService <- compare sessions + comparison-run store
|       |   `-- Uses selected comparison runtime
|       |-- JudgementService <- compare sessions + comparison service + run stores
|       |-- ExperimentService <- experiment store + EVALS + STORE + CONTEXTS
|       `-- [C] Explicit callbacks connect these shared instances
|           |-- agentChat.observeGenerations -> EVALS.recordLegacy
|           |   `-- Reconciliation rejection -> console.error
|           |-- CATALOG.snapshot(id, checkpoint) -> EVALS.outputSnapshot(id, checkpoint)
|           |-- EVALS replay/cancel legacy -> agentChat.rerunAlternatives/cancelGeneration
|           |-- EVALS.readChangeSession -> changes.get
|           `-- EVALS.deleteContextComparisons -> comparisonRuns.deleteContextOutputs
|-- [C] Vite transport lifecycle: diagramApi -> createBackend -> plugin hooks
|   |-- configureServer / configurePreviewServer -> attach(server)
|   |   |-- Mount HTTP middleware
|   |   `-- If an HTTP server exists: attachLiveCanvasSockets(server, backend.liveCanvas)
|   |       `-- Context uploads and canvas writes enabled only when httpEnabled == true
|   |-- Incoming HTTP request -> middleware
|   |   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next()
|   |   |-- Classified agent mutation + HTTP disabled + no x-canvas-chat-binding header
|   |   |   `-- 403 HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED
|   |   |-- Not /api/<known namespace>/... -> 404
|   |   `-- Known namespace -> await routes[namespace](request, response, url)
|   |       |-- [M] /api/core: injected core, source and catalog services
|   |       |   |-- Files / source / definitions -> ProjectSourceService
|   |       |   |   `-- [O] Definitions request owns AbortController and close listener
|   |       |   |       |-- Premature response close -> abort definitions lookup
|   |       |   |       `-- finally -> remove listener; send result only if not destroyed
|   |       |   |-- Projections / compaction listing -> ProjectCatalogService
|   |       |   `-- Compaction upsert / representations -> CoreApplication
|   |       `-- [M] /api/mapping: injected mapping services
|   |           |-- Agent, agent chat, live context/selection -> agent and live services
|   |           |-- Integrations / diff workflows -> push and workflow handlers
|   |           |-- Generated canvases / evals -> EVALS, prompts and references
|   |           |-- Compare sessions / comparison runs -> comparison handlers
|   |           |-- Workspace load/save, records, export and import-context preparation
|   |           |   `-- Body-bearing workspace operations allow up to 64 MiB
|   |           |-- Diagram save/delete/publish -> MappingDiagramService
|   |           |-- Local chat / compactions -> their dedicated handlers
|   |           |-- POST prompt -> selection.prepare(body)
|   |           |   `-- Flush NDJSON headers -> selection.run(prepared input)
|   |           |       `-- Emit progress callbacks -> result event -> response.end()
|   |           `-- Optional route families require injected services; unmatched -> 404
|   |-- Thrown route error -> transport translation
|   |   |-- Headers already sent -> error event; end response if still writable
|   |   `-- Otherwise -> JSON error
|   |       |-- RequestTooLarge -> 413; ProjectDiagramConflict -> 409
|   |       |-- ApplicationError -> 400 / 409 / 415 / 503 by error code
|   |       `-- Other errors -> 400
|   `-- [O] HTTP server close -> disposeSockets() -> backend.dispose()
|       |-- Calls dispose in order: comparisonRuns -> evalRuns -> agentChat
|       |-- Then diffSessionWorkflows -> agent -> diagramEditRuntime -> BRIDGE
|       `-- Then optional languageService -> mappingRuntime -> chatRuntime -> compactionService
|-- [M] Browser composition: App owns a MappingServices bundle in React state
|   |-- createMappingServices() supplies
|   |   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService('current')
|   |   |-- httpDiagramGenerator
|   |   |-- createHttpCodeRepoService()
|   |   `-- WorkspaceStorage
|   |-- [C] Path equals BASE_URL + "evals" after trailing-slash normalization
|   |   `-- Lazy EvalsPage under Suspense receives services
|   |-- Other paths, including unknown legacy paths -> MappingPocPage receives services
|   `-- ThemeToggle rendered alongside either page
`-- [M] Architecture tests constrain dependency direction and internal operations
    |-- Allowed internal import targets, still subject to feature ownership
    |   |-- Domain -> domain
    |   |-- Application -> application + domain
    |   |-- Infrastructure -> infrastructure + application + domain
    |   |-- UI -> UI + domain + packages
    |   |-- Ordinary server -> server + application + domain
    |   `-- Server bootstrap -> server + application + infrastructure + domain
    |-- Feature boundary
    |   |-- Non-composition code -> own feature or core; cannot import composition code
    |   `-- Composition code may cross feature boundaries within allowed layers
    |-- External import restrictions
    |   |-- Domain: no node:, React or Vite; UI: no node:
    |   `-- Application: no listed Node I/O modules, React, Vite or specified agent/RPC packages
    `-- Diagram model keeps construction and prepared edits internal
        |-- constructDiagram calls restricted to diagramRevisionEditor and submitDiagramEdit
        `-- prepareCreate / prepareEdit calls restricted to diagramRevision"}
